text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da. A "Curren-chan Doll" stitched with 
love and cuteness, poke by poke, by 
Machan. How do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I got the cutest birthday present 
ever☆ Thanks, Mar-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And behold, that is not all! Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! It's a Chan-Ma doll~♪\nCould this 
one be for Curren, too?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"'Exaaactly. My name is "Curren-chan 
Doll's Bestie Chan-Me Doll".'"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"'I'm a super capable mascot who can 
snuggle up right next to Curren-chan Doll 
anytime☆'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Having a friend with you is 
wonderful! Aren't you glad, Curren doll?♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, do your duty diligently, 
Mar-chan doll. No matter what happens, sit 
politely and look cute right by Curren-san 
and the others.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—No matter what happens. You will 
always...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Look, the Curren doll is saying 
something to Chan-me? ...Mm-hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Next year, will you celebrate for Curren 
Doll and Mar-chan Doll's birthdays too?", 
it says☆

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whoops-a-daisy. That's a crucial mission 
we can't just leave to a Chan-Maru doll, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill the mission... Machan needs to 
sit properly until next year too.
